post.title: Home Addition Mukilteo WA — Going Up or Out on a Coastal Lot: City Permits, Tree Rules, and Weatherproof-First Sequencing
post.description: Planning a home addition or second story in Mukilteo: confirm city jurisdiction, use the City of Mukilteo online permit portal, check tree and steep-slope rules, file electrical with L&I, and keep dry-in on the critical path.
